SELECT e.*, m.id AS m_id, m.NAME AS m_name, a.id AS a_id, a.manage_ip AS a_manage_ip, a.sn AS a_sn, a.purchase_date AS a_purchase_date, a.dc_id AS a_dc_id, a.model_id AS a_model_id, a.cabinet_id AS a_cabinet_id, a.NAME AS a_name, p.id AS p_id, p.NAME AS p_name, IFNULL( msg.alertNum, 0 ) AS alertNum FROM (select e.* from monitor_endpoint e left join monitor_endpoint_state es on e.id = es.endpoint_id
AND es.state IN
#{state}
OR es.state >= 2
AND es.type IN
#{type}
AND es.state IN
#{metricsState}
OR es.state > 1
AND es.type = 'metrics'
OR
AND
(es.state IN
#{logsState}
OR es.state > 1
AND es.type = 'logs')
group by e.id ) e LEFT JOIN monitor_module m ON e.module_id = m.id LEFT JOIN monitor_project p ON m.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN asset_asset a ON e.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT endpoint_id, count( 1 ) AS alertNum FROM alert_message_active WHERE endpoint_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY endpoint_id ) msg ON e.id = msg.endpoint_id
e.id IN
#{id}
AND p.id IN
#{projectId}
AND e.module_id IN
#{moduleId}
AND a.id IN
#{assetId}
AND e.name like CONCAT('%', #{params.name}, '%')
AND a.name like CONCAT('%', #{params.assetName}, '%')
ORDER BY e.id

SELECT DISTINCT me.id FROM monitor_endpoint me LEFT JOIN asset_asset ass ON me.asset_id = ass.id LEFT JOIN asset_state_conf state ON ass.state_id = state.id WHERE state.monitor = 0 OR me.enabled = 0
AND ass.id = #{assetId}

SELECT endpoint.id AS endpoint_id, endpoint.name AS endpoint_name, endpoint.module_id AS endpoint_module_id, endpoint.asset_id AS endpoint_asset_id,
endConf.id AS endConf_id, endConf.endpoint_id AS endConf_endpoint_id, endConf.config AS endConf_config, endConf.hash AS endConf_hash, endConf.version AS endConf_version,
module.id AS module_id, module.project_id AS module_project_id, module.name AS module_name, module.configs AS module_configs, module.snmp_yml AS module_snmp_yml,
project.id AS project_id, project.name AS project_name,
asset.id AS asset_id, asset.sn AS asset_sn, asset.name AS asset_name, asset.manage_ip AS asset_manage_ip, asset.dc_id AS asset_dc_id, asset.pid AS asset_pid, client_host AS asset_client_host, client_port AS asset_client_port, client_token AS asset_client_token,
dc.id AS dc_id, dc.name AS dc_name FROM monitor_endpoint endpoint LEFT JOIN monitor_endpoint_config endConf ON endpoint.id = endConf.endpoint_id LEFT JOIN monitor_module module ON endpoint.module_id = module.id LEFT JOIN monitor_project project ON module.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN asset_asset asset ON endpoint.asset_id = asset.id LEFT JOIN asset_state_conf state ON asset.state_id = state.id LEFT JOIN dc dc ON asset.dc_id = dc.id WHERE endConf.type = "metrics" AND endConf.enable = 1 AND state.monitor = 1 AND dc.state = 'ON'

SELECT endpoint.id AS endpoint_id, endpoint.name AS endpoint_name, endpoint.module_id AS endpoint_module_id, endpoint.asset_id AS endpoint_asset_id,
endConf.id AS endConf_id, endConf.endpoint_id AS endConf_endpoint_id, endConf.config AS endConf_config, endConf.hash AS endConf_hash, endConf.version AS endConf_version,
module.id AS module_id, module.project_id AS module_project_id, module.name AS module_name, module.configs AS module_configs, module.snmp_yml AS module_snmp_yml,
project.id AS project_id, project.name AS project_name,
asset.id AS asset_id, asset.sn AS asset_sn, asset.name AS asset_name, asset.manage_ip AS asset_manage_ip, asset.dc_id AS asset_dc_id, asset.pid AS asset_pid, client_host AS asset_client_host, client_port AS asset_client_port, client_token AS asset_client_token,
dc.id AS dc_id, dc.name AS dc_name FROM monitor_endpoint endpoint LEFT JOIN monitor_endpoint_config endConf ON endpoint.id = endConf.endpoint_id LEFT JOIN monitor_module module ON endpoint.module_id = module.id LEFT JOIN monitor_project project ON module.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN asset_asset asset ON endpoint.asset_id = asset.id LEFT JOIN dc dc ON asset.dc_id = dc.id WHERE endConf.type = "logs" AND endConf.enable = 1 AND asset.client_enable = 1 AND dc.state = 'ON'

SELECT e.*,
ass.id AS ass_id, ass.sn AS ass_sn, ass.NAME AS ass_name, ass.manage_ip AS ass_manage_ip, ass.dc_id AS ass_dc_id,
state.id as ass_state_id, state.name as ass_state_name, state.monitor as ass_state_monitor,
dc.id AS dc_id, dc.NAME AS dc_name, dc.state as dc_state FROM monitor_endpoint e LEFT JOIN asset_asset ass ON e.asset_id = ass.id LEFT JOIN asset_state_conf state ON ass.state_id = state.id LEFT JOIN dc dc ON ass.dc_id = dc.id
